items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: There was Marcus Foss, the drummer who called me Junior, that type of thing. And Don Abney who was the piano player, and all these guys were well seasoned.

ctx.x: Man, you were paying some dues I guess.

I think I lost about, at that time I lost about ten or fifteen pounds. Of course today that would be great. But anyway that went on for a while and then I says I have to do something about this. I says it’s time for me to make a change. Because I’ve heard other people talking about that they needed a trade, and they were tired of going from one gig to the other and so on. But during this time in Boston, I got one good gig, I think I had a week with Ella. She was coming through Boston, or was in Boston already and…
